> ## Verified facts
>
> - BHP, a funding and technical-support participant in the consortium, reports
>   that the MHI carbon-capture pilot successfully began operating on
>   ArcelorMittal Gent blast-furnace off-gas.
> - It reports an initial test rate of about 300 kg CO2/day and a planned
>   one-to-two-year pilot period.
> - The first phase tests blast-furnace top gas; the second phase is intended to
>   test off-gases from the hot-strip-mill reheating furnace.
>
